caption: The drawing depicts the bust of a man with a dark mustache, goatee, and wavy, black hair. He is wearing a large, wide-brimmed, green hat with a folded brim tilted toward his left. His facial features are pronounced: pronounced cheekbones, deeply set, brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, and visible facial lines and creases. The man is dressed in a green cape or cloak draped over his shoulders and a grayish shirt with a collar visible at the neckline. The background is plain, off-white, with no visible objects or scenery. The colors used are mainly green for the hat and outer garment, gray and beige for the shirt, brown and peach tones for the skin, black for the hair and facial hair, with some shading and lines accentuating the texture of the clothes and face. There is a small signature or inscription in the lower right corner: "FLORIAN ROKITA."
title: Cigar Store Figure
